spatialroute.title: Route service URL
spatialroute.remarks: The URL of the ESRI route service that is used to create routes between two points on the map. Route services run on external geographic information system (GIS) servers. The default values can change if the external GIS service is modified.

spatialdistancematrix.title: Distance matrix service URL - Direct Request
spatialdistancematrix.remarks: The URL of the ESRI Maps Distance Matrix service that is used to find the travel times between combinations of a set of origins and a set of destinations. Distance Matrix services run on external geographic information system (GIS) servers. The default values can change if the external GIS service is modified.

mapname.title: Map
mapname.remarks: The name of the map configuration.

spatialgeocode.title: Geocode service URL
spatialgeocode.remarks: The URL of the ESRI geocode service that the map uses to find a location that is based on an address or point. Geocode services run on external geographic information system (GIS) servers. The default values can change if the external GIS service is modified.

linearlayeroptionname.title: Sigoption Name
linearlayeroptionname.remarks: Signature Option Name to control the Maximo Linear Graphic Layers

carbonmap.title: MAF map component
carbonmap.remarks: Available in apps outside of Maximo Application Suite, but in the Maximo Application Framework, such as Maximo Mobile and Maximo Health and Predict.

spatialpassword.title: ESRI password
spatialpassword.remarks: To access ESRI Maps paid services, enter the ESRI password.

ismobile.title: Is Mobile
ismobile.remarks: Indicates whether the map is designed for use on a mobile device.

gmapsdistancematrix.title: Distance matrix service URL
gmapsdistancematrix.remarks: The URL of the Google Maps Distance Matrix service that is used to find the travel times between combinations of a set of origins and a set of destinations. Distance Matrix services run on external geographic information system (GIS) servers. The default values can change if the external GIS service is modified.

activelinearlayer.title: Activate Maximo Linear Graphic Layers
activelinearlayer.remarks: Enables the Linear Graphic Layers on the map for the sites that you specified

active.title: Enable map
active.remarks: Enables the map for the sites that you specified.

bmapshttps.title: Enable HTTPS
bmapshttps.remarks: Enables HTTPS support for Bing Maps.

spatialjobmatrix.title: Distance matrix service URL - Job Request
spatialjobmatrix.remarks: The URL to be used in the ESRI Maps Matrix Job service.

optcleanup.title: Optimization Cleanup
optcleanup.remarks: Amount of days before cached travel time data needs to be deleted from the optimization matrix table.

bmapsroute.title: Bing Maps route service URL
bmapsroute.remarks: The URL of the Bing Maps route service that is used to create routes between two points on the map. Route services run on external geographic information system (GIS) servers. The default values can change if the external GIS service is modified.

bmapsgeocode.title: Geocode service URL
bmapsgeocode.remarks: The URL of the Bing geocode service that the map uses to find a location that is based on an address or point. Geocode services run on external geographic information system (GIS) servers. The default values can change if the external GIS service is modified.

bmapsdistancematrix.title: Distance matrix service URL
bmapsdistancematrix.remarks: The URL of the Bing Maps Distance Matrix service that is used to find the travel times between combinations of a set of origins and a set of destinations. Distance Matrix services run on external geographic information system (GIS) servers. The default values can change if the external GIS service is modified.

spatialusername.title: ESRI user name
spatialusername.remarks: To access ESRI Maps paid services, enter the ESRI user name.
